analysis:
Examined docs/reference/configuration.md BASE lines 485–949 and the supplied bounded patch. Lines 485–920 are unchanged according to the complete range map: kernel eligibility, memory/media admission, weight verification, cache scope/TTL/key controls, cluster precision agreement and qualification-only logit capture do not establish new regressions. Existing resident-cache documentation differs from T-041's SSD-only posture, but this PR does not introduce that difference in these lines.
The change beginning at HEAD 923–936 documents signed-release registration of cluster_runtime through POST /v1/releases and coordinator derivation of approvals, pair-serving grants and parity qualifications, alongside the existing operator-file route. This is relevant to A-005, A-011, A-017, TB-011 and T-054: publication authority must not accidentally become independent qualification authority. The excerpt establishes the advertised contract, not its authorization implementation or a bypass, so no finding is supported here. BASE 931–949 identifies ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts.swift and helper/capability digest bindings; no corresponding changed implementation or complete HEAD definition is supplied in these units.
Integration should examine the remaining configuration changes, docs/operations/provider-release.md, release payload construction, ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts.swift and the consumed platform approval contract to determine whether build-declared public models and parity claims require independently authorized qualification, and whether generated approvals preserve digest, generation, expiry and member-local validation. Missing implementation is a coverage limit, not evidence of either safety or regression.
